algorithm.name: Host-Guest Complementary Pathway Screening Algorithm
algorithm.mlPolicy: No training or inference is used. Dataset fields are aggregated by fixed rules.

familyAssignment.multiMetalPolicy: Use the first listed metal when a record has multiple metal nodes separated by ';', '/', ',', or '+'. If the first metal cannot be mapped, mark ambiguous and exclude from family aggregation.
familyAssignment.unclassifiedPolicy: Records not mapped to a target family are counted as unclassified and excluded from family aggregates.
familyAssignment.todo: Topology strings may not align with UiO/MOF-808/MIL hints in all imported records; report unmatched Zr topology counts for review.

hgcpsFormula: finalHGCPS = product(hostStabilityScore, hostPathwaySupportScore, guestActivityCompensationScore, hostGuestComplementarityScore, evidenceConfidenceScore, riskPenalty)

poreEnvironmentScore.descriptor: surface area, pore volume, and void fraction structural support
poreEnvironmentScore.aggregate: family median for each numeric field; combined as mean of normalized field medians

co2EnrichmentSupport.descriptor: CO2 adsorption support; fallback to structural void-fraction proxy when direct gas adsorption rows are sparse
co2EnrichmentSupport.aggregate: mean CO2 gas-adsorption score for mapped family when nRecords >= threshold; otherwise family voidFraction median proxy

stabilityProxy.descriptor: indirect aqueous survival proxy from water/aqueous reaction presence plus CoRE representation
stabilityProxy.aggregate: 0.7 * valid aqueous reaction share + 0.3 * normalized CoRE family record count

aqueousStabilityEvidence.aggregate: share of family reaction rows with water or aqueous solvent, yield > 0, and accepted validation status

thermalStabilityEvidence.aggregate: median family reaction temperature among positive-yield accepted rows

postModificationFeasibility.aggregate: curated fallback only because no imported dataset field represents this descriptor

guestHostingFeasibility.aggregate: curated fallback only because no imported dataset field represents this descriptor

provenanceQuality.aggregate: mean available provenance coverage for mapped records, falling back to DOI/citation coverage

guestFactorMappings.dataDerivedPolicy: Only derive a guest factor from reaction/literature/gold records when the guest metal appears as a primary metalNode with nRecords >= threshold. Otherwise use the existing literature prior and mark curated-literature-prior.
guestFactorMappings.performanceAggregate: mean of normalized yield, selectivity, and conversion across eligible records
guestFactorMappings.fallbackReason: No dedicated dopant or guest-metal dataset field is present in the imported data.

hostPathwaySupportScore.source: mean of derived host poreEnvironmentScore and co2EnrichmentSupport

guestActivityCompensationScore.source: derived or curated-literature-prior guest activity score

hostGuestComplementarityScore.source: deterministic complementarity between host weak dimensions and guest strong dimensions

evidenceConfidenceScore.source: literature and gold records for mapped host family and target product
evidenceConfidenceScore.aggregate: weighted evidence count using quality tier and provenance coverage; Gold > Silver > Bronze
evidenceConfidenceScore.normalization: cross-route min-max with floor for sparse evidence

riskPenalty.aggregate: risk retention rises with evidence count and same-condition/comparability coverage; sparse evidence lowers the multiplicative factor

provenanceTuple.recordRefs: Include real source ids or citations when available.
provenanceTuple.fallbackPolicy: Every fallback value must include curated-fallback or curated-literature-prior, nRecords, rawAggregate, and fallback reason.

sensitivity.reportedMetric: top route rank stability and top-k membership under reasonable weight and normalization perturbations

forbidden: Hard-code final ranking or finalHGCPS values
Treat curated fallback values as data-derived
Use guest or dopant metals as retrieval filters for host-family evidence
